params.require: x5 >= 1 and x5 <= 60 and x5 not in k
params.why: missing value must be positive and new

params.name: ss
params.let: sum([(x - m) ** 2 for x in all])

stem: Four of five values are ${=k[0]}, {=k[1]}, {=k[2]}, {=k[3]}$ and the fifth value is unknown. The mean of the five values is ${=m}$. Find the fifth value, then calculate the standard deviation of the five values. Round the standard deviation to 2 decimal places and give only the standard deviation.
solution: Since $\bar{x}=\dfrac{\sum x}{n}$, the total of the five values is $5\times {=m}={=5*m}$
The four known values total ${=sk}$, so the fifth value is ${=5*m}-{=sk}={=x5}$
The values are ${=all[0]}, {=all[1]}, {=all[2]}, {=all[3]}, {=all[4]}$ with squared deviations from ${=m}$: ${=(all[0]-m)**2}, {=(all[1]-m)**2}, {=(all[2]-m)**2}, {=(all[3]-m)**2}, {=(all[4]-m)**2}$
notes: Twist: find the missing value from the given mean, then compute sigma (population formula).
